step1_analysis.description: A single NMOS transistor acting as a switch or driver for an inductive load. In the context of the paper, this represents the main driver transistor before the active feedback circuitry is added.

paper_reference.title: A Novel Active Feedback Flyback With Only 100-mV Inductive Overshoot for a Standard Low-Voltage CMOS Inductive Load Driver, in a Single-Chip Controller for 73 Relays in a POTS/ADSL

r_on.description: On-resistance of the NMOS switch in the linear region

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using standard square-law model for linear region at VGS=1.8V. Actual value may vary due to velocity saturation and mobility degradation.

vth.description: Threshold voltage of the NMOS driver

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard SKY130 1.8V device parameters.

i_off.description: Off-state leakage current when VGS=0V and VDS=1.8V

sky130_expected.reasoning: Leakage is highly dependent on temperature and exact subthreshold slope, but typically in the pA range for a 5um wide device at room temperature.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the on-resistance, threshold voltage, and off-state leakage of the NMOS driver switch.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for NMOS Switch
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Stimulus
VGS N0 GND 0
VDS N1_drain GND 1.8
VD_meas N1_drain N1 0

.control
* 1. DC Sweep VGS for Vth and I_off
dc VGS 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc i_off find i(VD_meas) at=0
* Vth measured at Id = 1uA * (W/L) = 10uA
meas dc vth find v(N0) when i(VD_meas)=10u

* 2. DC Sweep VDS for R_on
alter VGS 1.8
dc VDS 0 0.2 0.01
meas dc id_at_100mv find i(VD_meas) at=0.1
let r_on = 0.1 / id_at_100mv
print r_on

quit
.endc
